scope: Tool-session cancellation, project ownership and attribute-tab coordination
assertions: One scene cleanup path cancels drawing, model editing and graphic editing and invalidates completed or pending temporary measurements
Switching tools, opening resource/group/rename/delete dialogs, Esc, history and project replacement use that cleanup path
Drawing/edit callbacks require the same runtime, generation and live project epoch, including synchronous Enter during reopening of the same project ID
Continuous point placement resumes only its own intent and still commits each accepted click exactly once
Removed, hidden or effectively locked targets cancel the owning edit session
Geometry commit preflights target identity, inherited visibility/lock and the exact original geometry before replacement; rejected commits refresh authoritative content
Temporary measurement cards and native data sources return to baseline after selection or Esc, without project history changes
A fresh graphic edit after cancellation commits once and undoes back to the exact original geometry
2D box selection, explicit attribute-table commands and filters activate the attribute tab after diagnostics/tasks
Ant Design 6 outer tab body sizing is scoped to its direct containers, preserving nested attribute-table cell pointer input and real double-click location
2D Esc cancellation retains original feature data, selection and camera behavior
boundaries: Cesium terrain sampling has no AbortSignal contract here; invalidated results are discarded rather than claiming the network request was aborted
Browser/SwiftShader behavior does not sign off Windows focus-loss, physical pointer devices, IME or GPU acceptance
No screenshot-based handle discovery or visual comparison was used in this batch
